translations.web: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
translations.bsb: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
translations.kjv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
translations.asv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
